basic_details.job_title: RGNAU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Visiting Medical Consultant and Health Inspector Posts
basic_details.post_name: Visiting Medical Consultant and Health Inspector

qualification.education_qualification: MD/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology with 1 year experience, MD/DNB in Paediatrics with 1 year experience, Diploma/Certificate in Health Inspector/Sanitary Inspector/Public Health with 5 years experience
qualification.details: Visiting Medical Consultant (Gynaecology & Obstetrics): MD (Doctor of Medicine) /DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute /Hospital /Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01 (One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Medical Consultant (Paediatrician): MD (Doctor of Medicine) /DNB in Paediatrics (with valid medical council registration) from a Government recognized Institute / Hospital / Organization affiliated with Medical Council of India or State Medical Council. A minimum experience of 01 (One) year working with Government Hospital / Organizations / reputed and recognised Private Hospital is mandatory. Visiting Health Inspector: Diploma/Certificate in Health Inspector/Sanitary Inspector/Public Health from a recognized Institution. A minimum experience of 5 years in health inspection, sanitation, hygiene and public-health activities, particularly in educational institutions, hostels, hospitals or large residential establishments is mandatory. Desirable: Practical knowledge of Food Safety and Standard Authority of India (FSSAI) guidelines, Integrated Pest Management (IPM) protocols and drinking water quality testing parameters.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGNAU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) located in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, offering multiple professional contractual opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for positions including Visiting Medical Consultant in Gynaecology & Obstetrics, Paediatrics, and Visiting Health Inspector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the various posts at Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: All interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the online mode by visiting the official website before the prescribed deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What are the qualification requirements for Visiting Medical Consultants?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD or DNB degree in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or Paediatrics with a valid medical council registration and at least 1 year of professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Visiting Health Inspector post?
faq.answer: Applicants require a Diploma or Certificate in Health Inspector, Sanitary Inspector, or Public Health along with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in institutional sanitation.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is Nil for all categories including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates wishing to apply for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official RGNAU notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF directly from the Important Links section provided within this recruitment article or via the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions at RGNAU?
faq.answer: The positions offered under advertisement number RGNAU/5132/03/ADMIN/517 are strictly contractual in nature, suitable for qualified medical and health professionals.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the RGNAU Various Posts Online Form 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants should click on the 'Apply Online' link provided in the important links section, fill out the form carefully, upload necessary documents, and submit it before the deadline.
